name: Matt Ishida & Tai Kamiya
main_effect:
[Your Turn] When you play a [Gabumon] or [Agumon], you may suspend this Tamer to gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves, if you have 1 or fewer Digimon, you may play 1 [Gabumon] if that Digimon has [Greymon] in its name or 1 [Agumon] if that Digimon has [Garurumon] in its name from your hand or trash without paying its cost.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
